name: Meridian Logistic Group
desc: Meridian Logistic Group transformed its global financial operations by replacing manual, error-prone Excel processes with Prophix. The transition enabled the logistics leader to slash its close cycle by 71% and unlock millions in trapped cash through real-time visibility.
whoText: Meridian Logistic Group is a global leader in third-party logistics, including warehousing, freight, and last-mile delivery. Headquartered in Brussels, the company manages complex operations across 14 countries with a lean, high-performing finance team of 28.

krs.text: Reduced the quarterly close process from 21 days to just six days.
Automated intercompany reconciliations, reducing the process from eight days to four hours.
Gained real-time visibility into cash positions across 12 currencies, identifying €4.2 million in trapped cash.
Transitioned finance staff from manual data entry to high-value FP&A activities.

data.label: THE CHALLENGE
data.heading: Breaking Free from 'Heroic' Excel Processes
data.body:
Operating across 14 countries with 47 different spreadsheet templates, Meridian’s finance team was trapped in an unsustainable cycle. The team spent three weeks every quarter manually consolidating data, leading to audit risks, material restatements, and staff burnout.

James Okafor, CFO, noted that the process was 'heroic in the wrong way,' with finance professionals working fourteen-hour days just to keep up with the manual reconciliation burden.

data.label: THE SOLUTION
data.heading: Automating Global Consolidation
data.body:
Meridian turned to Prophix to standardize their financial operations. By implementing Financial Consolidation and Intercompany Management, the team replaced fragmented spreadsheets with a unified, automated platform.

The implementation was completed in just four months, allowing the team to move from a manual, error-prone environment to a streamlined, audit-ready system that provided the board and PE sponsors with newfound confidence in their financial data.

data.label: THE RESULTS
data.heading: Transformative Financial Clarity
data.body:
The impact on the business was immediate. Beyond the 71% reduction in the close cycle, the finance team successfully redeployed two staff members from manual consolidation to strategic FP&A work. 

Furthermore, the treasury team gained real-time visibility into global liquidity, enabling them to identify and redeploy €4.2 million in trapped cash within the first month of use.

data.title: THE FIRST CLOSE
data.quote: The first close on Prophix felt like cheating. And I mean that in the best possible way.

data.title: THE COST OF MANUAL WORK
data.quote: You are spending human capital on work that software should be doing, and that cost is invisible until you stop doing it.
